objective: Validate public UPI schemas and example contracts without scanning index content for scientific errors.
steps: Validate example workflow, skill, routine, ledger and handoff documents.
Write a durable pass/fail artifact. Do not mutate sources.
anti_patterns: Manager running schema validation instead of routing it
Using schema validation as experimental evidence
Sharing debug-index capabilities with this role

acceptance_tests.criterion: Example governed-system contracts validate against their schemas.

changelog.change: Added after three index-triage baselines; tools differ from debug-index.

confusion_guard: Schema validity is a software contract check, not scientific verification.
